annotations.title: Keep an image for a page

description: Keep a copy of an image you already have on MintPage, for example one you generated with your own image tool (Gemini, Grok, DALL-E…), whose links usually expire. Send exactly one of url (public https link) or data (the file as base64 or a data: URL). PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or AVIF, up to 10 MB; no SVG. Returns a permanent url plus ready-made markdown and html. Put it in a page with the returned markdown or html (or its url in an ): the link is permanent and works in MintPage pages; other sites can't embed it. Requires an API key (free: 25 images, Pro: 500).

data.description: The image file as base64, or a data:image/...;base64,... URL.

description.description: Short description, used as the alt text.

url.description: A public https:// link to the image file.

name: add_image
